1	# Adapt from https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/b1efb3c7126ef7615e8c333432d76e08038e17ff/pretrain_gpt.py
2	import argparse
3	import inspect
4	import re
5	from contextlib import nullcontext
6	from typing import Literal
7	
8	import torch
9	from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
10	from megatron.core.models.gpt import GPTModel
11	from megatron.core.models.gpt.gpt_layer_specs import (
12	    get_gpt_decoder_block_spec,
13	    get_gpt_layer_local_spec,
14	    get_gpt_layer_with_transformer_engine_spec,
15	)
16	from megatron.core.transformer.spec_utils import import_module
17	from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
18	from megatron.training.arguments import core_transformer_config_from_args
19	
20	from slime.utils.misc import load_function
21	
22	_INDEXER_DIRECT_SUBMODULE_NAMES = frozenset(
23	    {
24	        "wq_b",
25	        "wk",
26	        "k_norm",
27	        "weights_proj",
28	        "index_kpool_compress_ape",
29	        "index_kpool_compress_gate",
30	    }
31	)
32	
33	
34	def _is_indexer_parameter(name: str) -> bool:
35	    """Return whether *name* belongs to a DSA indexer.
36	
37	    The GLM plugin exposes indexer projections directly under
38	    ``self_attention``. Megatron's upstream DSA implementation instead nests
39	    them under ``self_attention.core_attention.indexer``. Keep the ownership
40	    check structural so similarly named non-indexer projections stay trainable.
41	    """
42	
43	    parts = name.split(".")
44	    for index, part in enumerate(parts):
45	        if part != "self_attention" or index + 1 >= len(parts):
46	            continue
47	        attention_parts = parts[index + 1 :]
48	        if attention_parts[0] in _INDEXER_DIRECT_SUBMODULE_NAMES:
49	            return True
50	        if "indexer" in attention_parts[:-1]:
51	            return True
52	    return False
53	
54	
55	# Adapt from https://github.com/volcengine/verl/blob/c3b20575d2bc815fcccd84bddb4c0401fc4b632b/verl/models/llama/megatron/layers/parallel_linear.py#L82
56	class LinearForLastLayer(torch.nn.Linear):
57	    # WORKSPACE CHANGE, part of the shared setup: `bias` defaults to False
58	    # here, where upstream slime v0.3.2 defaults it to True.
59	    #
60	    # Upstream cannot load a critic from a HuggingFace checkpoint at all. The
61	    # HF loader walks every Megatron parameter and asks the model's mapper for
62	    # a source tensor; `output_layer.weight` is special-cased (a [1, hidden]
63	    # value head is skipped when the HF tensor is [vocab, hidden]), but
64	    # `output_layer.bias` has no HF counterpart and no special case, so
65	    # `qwen_hf_tensor` raises KeyError("Unsupported Megatron parameter
66	    # 'output_layer.bias'") before training starts. See
67	    # slime/backends/megatron_utils/hf_to_megatron/{qwen,common}.py.
68	    #
69	    # A value head does not need a bias -- it is one scalar of freedom that
70	    # V(s) can equally express through the backbone -- and dropping it is the
71	    # smallest change that lets a critic start from HF weights, which is what
72	    # Stage B does.
73	    def __init__(
74	        self,
75	        input_size: int,
76	        output_size: int,
77	        *,
78	        config: TransformerConfig,
79	        bias: bool = False,
80	    ) -> None:
81	        super().__init__(in_features=input_size, out_features=output_size, bias=bias)
82	        self.sequence_parallel = config.sequence_parallel
83	        if self.sequence_parallel:
84	            self.weight.sequence_parallel = True
85	            if bias:
86	                self.bias.sequence_parallel = True
87	
88	        init_method_std = getattr(config, "init_method_std", None)
89	        if init_method_std is None:
90	            init_method_std = 0.02
91	        self.weight.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=init_method_std)
92	        if bias:
93	            self.bias.data.zero_()
94	
95	    def forward(
96	        self,
97	        input_: torch.Tensor,
98	        weight: torch.Tensor | None = None,
99	        runtime_gather_output: bool | None = None,
100	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, None]:
101	        logits = super().forward(input_)
102	        logits = logits.float()
103	        if self.sequence_parallel:
104	            logits = tensor_parallel.gather_from_sequence_parallel_region(logits, tensor_parallel_output_grad=False)
105	        return logits, None
106	
107	
108	def _get_model_provider_func(
109	    args: argparse.Namespace,
110	    role: Literal["actor", "critic"] = "actor",
111	):
112	    # Support custom model provider path (similar to --custom-rm-path for reward models)
113	    if getattr(args, "custom_model_provider_path", None):
114	
115	        def wrapped_model_provider(
116	            pre_process: bool = True, post_process: bool = True, vp_stage: int | None = None
117	        ) -> GPTModel:
118	            custom_model_provider = load_function(args.custom_model_provider_path)
119	            # Check if the custom provider supports vp_stage parameter
120	            has_vp_stage = "vp_stage" in inspect.signature(custom_model_provider).parameters
121	            if has_vp_stage:
122	                model = custom_model_provider(pre_process=pre_process, post_process=post_process, vp_stage=vp_stage)
123	            else:
124	                model = custom_model_provider(pre_process=pre_process, post_process=post_process)
125	            # Apply critic output layer if needed
126	            if post_process and role == "critic":
127	                model.output_layer = LinearForLastLayer(
128	                    input_size=model.config.hidden_size, output_size=1, config=model.config
129	                )
130	            return model
131	
132	        return wrapped_model_provider
133	
134	    def model_provider(pre_process: bool = True, post_process: bool = True, vp_stage: int | None = None) -> GPTModel:
135	        """Builds the model.
136	
137	        If you set the use_legacy_models to True, it will return the legacy GPT model and if not the mcore GPT model.
138	
139	        Args:
140	            pre_process (bool, optional): Set to true if you need to compute embedings. Defaults to True.
141	            post_process (bool, optional): Set to true if you need to want to compute output logits/loss. Defaults to True.
142	
143	
144	        Returns:
145	            Union[GPTModel, megatron.legacy.model.GPTModel]: The returned model
146	        """
147	        use_te = args.transformer_impl == "transformer_engine"
148	
149	        # Experimental loading arguments from yaml
150	        config: TransformerConfig = core_transformer_config_from_args(args)
151	        # Older GLM Megatron forks consumed this flag from TransformerConfig.
152	        # Preserve that contract for custom specs, while freeze_model_params()
153	        # below provides the concrete implementation on current Megatron.
154	        config.freeze_indexer = getattr(args, "freeze_indexer", False)
155	
156	        if args.spec is not None:
157	            transformer_layer_spec = import_module(args.spec)

30	    def __contains__(self, name: str) -> bool:
31	        return name in self.weight_map

33	    @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)  # noqa: B019 - cache belongs to this reader instance
34	    def get_tensor(self, name: str) -> torch.Tensor:
35	        try:
36	            filename = self.weight_map[name]
37	        except KeyError as exc:

39	        if filename not in self._files:

42	        scale_name = f"{name}_scale_inv"

44	            scale_file = self.weight_map[scale_name]
45	            if scale_file not in self._files:
46	                self._files[scale_file] = safe_open(self.path / scale_file, framework="pt", device="cpu")
47	            scale = self._files[scale_file].get_tensor(scale_name).to(torch.bfloat16)
48	            rows, columns = tensor.shape

53	            )

61	    while name.startswith("module."):

66	def text_config(config):

70	def merge_qkv(q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor, config) -> torch.Tensor:
71	    config = text_config(config)
72	    num_groups = config.num_key_value_heads
73	    num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
74	    head_dim = getattr(config, "head_dim", None) or config.hidden_size // num_heads
75	    trailing_shape = q.shape[1:]
76	    q = q.reshape(num_groups, num_heads // num_groups * head_dim, *trailing_shape)
77	    k = k.reshape(num_groups, head_dim, *trailing_shape)
78	    v = v.reshape(num_groups, head_dim, *trailing_shape)
79	    return torch.cat((q, k, v), dim=1).reshape(-1, *trailing_shape).contiguous()

82	def merge_gate_up(gate: torch.Tensor, up: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
83	    return torch.cat((gate, up), dim=0)

86	def _tensor_parallel_shard(
87	    name: str,
88	    tensor: torch.Tensor,
89	    *,
90	    parallel_size: int,
91	    parallel_rank: int,
92	    partition_dim: int,
93	    partition_stride: int,
94	) -> torch.Tensor:
95	    if parallel_size == 1:
96	        return tensor
97	
98	    if "linear_fc1.weight" in name or "linear_fc1.bias" in name:
99	        gate, up = tensor.chunk(2, dim=partition_dim)
100	        gate = torch.chunk(gate, parallel_size, dim=partition_dim)[parallel_rank]
101	        up = torch.chunk(up, parallel_size, dim=partition_dim)[parallel_rank]
102	        return torch.cat((gate, up), dim=partition_dim).contiguous()
103	
104	    if "linear_fc2.weight" in name and partition_dim == 0:
105	        partition_dim = 1
106	
107	    chunks = torch.chunk(tensor, parallel_size * partition_stride, dim=partition_dim)
108	    return torch.cat(chunks[parallel_rank::parallel_size], dim=partition_dim).contiguous()

111	def shard_mcore_tensor(name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor, parameter: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
112	    from megatron.core import mpu
113	
114	    if (
115	        not getattr(parameter, "tensor_model_parallel", False)
116	        or getattr(parameter, "parallel_mode", None) == "duplicated"
117	    ):
118	        return tensor
119	
120	    if ".experts." in name:
121	        parallel_size = mpu.get_expert_tensor_parallel_world_size()
122	        parallel_rank = mpu.get_expert_tensor_parallel_rank()
123	    else:
124	        parallel_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
125	        parallel_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
126	
127	    return _tensor_parallel_shard(
128	        name,
129	        tensor,
130	        parallel_size=parallel_size,
131	        parallel_rank=parallel_rank,
132	        partition_dim=parameter.partition_dim,
133	        partition_stride=parameter.partition_stride,
134	    )

137	def _pad_vocab(args, name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
138	    if not (name.endswith("embedding.word_embeddings.weight") or name.endswith("output_layer.weight")):
139	        return tensor
140	    padded_size = getattr(args, "padded_vocab_size", None)
141	    if padded_size is None or tensor.shape[0] >= padded_size:
142	        return tensor
143	    return F.pad(tensor, (0, 0, 0, padded_size - tensor.shape[0]))

146	def load_model_hf_weights(
147	    args,
148	    model,
149	    path: str | Path,
150	    config,
151	    get_hf_tensor: Callable[[str, SafetensorReader, object], torch.Tensor],
152	) -> None:
153	    from slime.backends.megatron_utils.update_weight.common import named_params_and_buffers
154	
155	    reader = SafetensorReader(path)
156	    with torch.no_grad():
157	        for name, parameter in named_params_and_buffers(args, model):
158	            tensor = get_hf_tensor(name, reader, config)
159	            if name.endswith("output_layer.weight") and parameter.shape[0] == 1 and tensor.shape[0] != 1:
160	                continue
161	            tensor = shard_mcore_tensor(name, _pad_vocab(args, name, tensor), parameter)
162	            if tensor.shape != parameter.shape:

164	                    f"Shape mismatch loading {name}: HuggingFace {tuple(tensor.shape)}, "
165	                    f"Megatron {tuple(parameter.shape)}"

    from torch.distributed._shard.sharded_tensor.shard import Shard
    from torch.distributed._shard.sharded_tensor.utils import _parse_and_validate_remote_device
    from torch.distributed._shard.sharding_spec.api import EnumerableShardingSpec

    def __post_init__(self):
        pass

    EnumerableShardingSpec.__post_init__ = __post_init__

    @classmethod
    def _init_from_local_shards_and_global_metadata(  # type: ignore[override]
        cls,
        local_shards: list[Shard],
        sharded_tensor_metadata: ShardedTensorMetadata,
        process_group=None,
        init_rrefs=False,
        sharding_spec=None,
    ) -> ShardedTensor:
        """
        Initialize a ShardedTensor with local shards and a global
        ShardedTensorMetadata built on each rank.

        Warning: This API is experimental and subject to change. It does
                 not do cross rank validations, and fully rely on the user
                 for the correctness of sharded_tensor_metadata on each rank
        """
        process_group = cls._normalize_pg(process_group)
        current_rank = dist.get_rank()  # intentional to get global rank

        shards_metadata = sharded_tensor_metadata.shards_metadata

        local_shard_metadatas = []

        # collect local shard metadatas from the global sharded_tensor_metadata
        for shard_metadata in shards_metadata:  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            rank, local_device = _parse_and_validate_remote_device(process_group, shard_metadata.placement)

            if current_rank == rank:
                local_shard_metadatas.append(shard_metadata)

        shards_metadata = sharded_tensor_metadata.shards_metadata
        tensor_properties = sharded_tensor_metadata.tensor_properties

        if sharding_spec is None:
            spec = shard_spec._infer_sharding_spec_from_shards_metadata(shards_metadata)
        else:
            spec = sharding_spec

        sharded_tensor = ShardedTensor.__new__(
            ShardedTensor,
            spec,
            sharded_tensor_metadata.size,
            dtype=tensor_properties.dtype,
            layout=tensor_properties.layout,
            pin_memory=tensor_properties.pin_memory,
            requires_grad=tensor_properties.requires_grad,
        )

        # done validation, add local_shards
        sharded_tensor._local_shards = local_shards
        sharded_tensor._prepare_init(process_group=process_group, init_rrefs=init_rrefs)

        # run post initialization, i.e. map registration, rpc initialization
        sharded_tensor._post_init()
        return sharded_tensor

    ShardedTensor._init_from_local_shards_and_global_metadata = _init_from_local_shards_and_global_metadata

except ImportError:
    pass

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

__all__ = ["save_checkpoint"]


def load_checkpoint(ddp_model, optimizer, opt_param_scheduler, checkpointing_context):
    # ref: how megatron `load_checkpoint` gets directory
    args = get_args()
    load_path = args.load

    assert Path(load_path).exists() and _is_dir_nonempty(
        load_path
    ), f"{args.load=} does not exist or is an empty directory. Did you specify the wrong folder?"

    if _is_megatron_checkpoint(load_path):
        return _load_checkpoint_megatron(
            ddp_model=ddp_model,
            optimizer=optimizer,
            opt_param_scheduler=opt_param_scheduler,
            checkpointing_context=checkpointing_context,
            skip_load_to_model_and_opt=False,
        )
    else:
        return _load_checkpoint_hf(
            ddp_model=ddp_model,
            optimizer=optimizer,
            args=args,
            load_path=load_path,
        )


def _is_megatron_checkpoint(path: str | Path) -> bool:
    return (Path(path) / "latest_checkpointed_iteration.txt").is_file() or bool(
        re.fullmatch(r"iter_\d{7}", Path(path).name)
    )


def _load_checkpoint_hf(ddp_model, optimizer, args, load_path: str):
    logger.info(f"Load checkpoint from HuggingFace model into Megatron (path={load_path})")
    from slime.backends.megatron_utils.hf_to_megatron import load_hf_weights

    load_hf_weights(args, ddp_model, load_path)

    # Copied from Megatron-core :: load_checkpoint (with simplifications)
    if (args.fp16 or args.bf16) and optimizer is not None:
        assert not args.load_main_params_from_ckpt
        optimizer.reload_model_params()

    # We can see `successfully loaded checkpoint from ... [ t 1/2, p 1/1 ] at iteration 0`
    # when loading Megatron, thus it is 0
    iteration = 0
    num_floating_point_operations_so_far = 0
    return iteration, num_floating_point_operations_so_far


def _is_dir_nonempty(path):
    with os.scandir(path) as it:
        return any(it)

347	@torch.no_grad()
348	def forward_only(
349	    f: Callable[..., dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]],
350	    args: Namespace,
351	    model: Sequence[DDP],
352	    data_iterator: Sequence[DataIterator],
353	    num_microbatches: Sequence[int],
354	    store_prefix: str = "",
355	    use_rollout_top_p_replay: bool = False,
356	) -> dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]:
357	    """Run forward passes only and collect non-loss outputs (e.g., logprobs).
358	
359	    The model is put into evaluation mode, a forward-only pipeline pass is
360	    executed, and relevant outputs are aggregated and returned.
361	
362	    Args:
363	        f (Callable[..., dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]]): Post-forward callback used to
364	            compute and package outputs to collect. This should accept a logits
365	            tensor as its first positional argument and additional keyword-only
366	            arguments; see ``get_log_probs_and_entropy``/``get_values`` in
367	            ``megatron_utils.loss`` for examples. It will be partially applied
368	            so that the callable returned from the internal forward step only
369	            requires the logits tensor.
370	        args (Namespace): Runtime arguments.
371	        model (Sequence[DDP]): Sequence of DDP-wrapped model chunks.
372	        data_iterator (Sequence[DataIterator]): Iterable(s) yielding batches for inference.
373	        num_microbatches (Sequence[int]): Number of microbatches per rollout step.
374	        store_prefix (str): Prefix to prepend to stored output keys.
375	        use_rollout_top_p_replay (bool): Whether to pass rollout top-p token sets
376	            to the post-forward log-prob callback when top-p rollout is enabled.
377	
378	    Returns:
379	        dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]: Aggregated outputs keyed by ``store_prefix + key``.
380	    """
381	
382	    # reset data iterator
383	    for iterator in data_iterator:
384	        iterator.reset()
385	
386	    config = get_model_config(model[0])
387	    batch_keys = [
388	        "tokens",
389	        "loss_masks",
390	        "multimodal_train_inputs",
391	        "total_lengths",
392	        "response_lengths",
393	    ]
394	    if use_rollout_top_p_replay:
395	        batch_keys = _with_rollout_top_p_token_keys(args, batch_keys)
396	
397	    def forward_step(
398	        data_iterator: DataIterator, model: GPTModel, return_schedule_plan: bool = False
399	    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, Callable[[torch.Tensor], dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]]]:
400	        """Forward step used by Megatron's pipeline engine.
401	
402	        Args:
403	            data_iterator (DataIterator): Input data iterator.
404	            model (GPTModel): The GPT model chunk to execute.
405	
406	        Returns:
407	            tuple[torch.Tensor, Callable[[torch.Tensor], dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]]]:
408	            Output tensor(s) and a callable that computes and packages results
409	            to be collected by the engine.
410	        """
411	
412	        assert not return_schedule_plan, "forward_only step should never return schedule plan"
413	
414	        # Get the batch.
415	        batch = get_batch(
416	            data_iterator,
417	            batch_keys,
418	            args.data_pad_size_multiplier,
419	            args.allgather_cp,
420	        )
421	        unconcat_tokens = batch["unconcat_tokens"]
422	        tokens = batch["tokens"]
423	        packed_seq_params = batch["packed_seq_params"]
424	        total_lengths = batch["total_lengths"]
425	        response_lengths = batch["response_lengths"]
426	        forward_kwargs = {
427	            "input_ids": tokens,
428	            "position_ids": None,
429	            "attention_mask": None,
430	            "labels": None,
431	            "packed_seq_params": packed_seq_params,
432	            "loss_mask": batch["full_loss_masks"],
433	        }
434	        if batch["multimodal_train_inputs"] is not None:
435	            forward_kwargs.update(batch["multimodal_train_inputs"])
436	        output_tensor = model(**forward_kwargs)
437	
438	        output_kwargs = {
439	            "args": args,
440	            "unconcat_tokens": unconcat_tokens,
441	            "total_lengths": total_lengths,
442	            "response_lengths": response_lengths,
443	            "with_entropy": args.use_rollout_entropy,
444	        }
445	        if use_rollout_top_p_replay:
446	            output_kwargs.update(get_rollout_top_p_logprob_kwargs(args, batch))
447	
448	        return output_tensor, partial(f, **output_kwargs)
449	
450	    # Turn on evaluation mode which disables dropout.
451	    for model_module in model:
452	        model_module.eval()
453	
454	    if args.custom_megatron_before_log_prob_hook_path:
455	        from slime.utils.misc import load_function
456	
457	        custom_before_log_prob_hook = load_function(args.custom_megatron_before_log_prob_hook_path)
458	        custom_before_log_prob_hook(args, model, store_prefix)
459	
460	    forward_backward_func = get_forward_backward_func()
461	    # Don't care about timing during evaluation
462	    config.timers = None
463	    forward_data_store = []
464	    num_steps_per_rollout = len(num_microbatches)
465	    microbatch_pbar = tqdm(
466	        total=sum(num_microbatches),
467	        desc=f"{(store_prefix or getattr(model[0], 'role', 'actor')).rstrip('_')} forward",
468	        unit="microbatch",
469	        dynamic_ncols=True,
470	        leave=False,
471	        disable=_disable_tqdm_for_non_main_rank(),
472	    )
473	    forward_step_with_progress = _wrap_forward_step_with_microbatch_pbar(forward_step, microbatch_pbar)
474	    for step_id in range(num_steps_per_rollout):
475	        forward_data_store += forward_backward_func(
476	            forward_step_func=forward_step_with_progress,
477	            data_iterator=data_iterator,
478	            model=model,
479	            num_microbatches=num_microbatches[step_id],
480	            seq_length=args.seq_length,
481	            micro_batch_size=args.micro_batch_size,
482	            forward_only=True,
483	        )
484	    microbatch_pbar.close()
485	
486	    # Move model back to the train mode.
487	    for model_module in model:
488	        model_module.train()
489	
490	    rollout_data = {}
491	    # Store the results on the last stage
492	    if mpu.is_pipeline_last_stage():
493	        keys = forward_data_store[0].keys()
494	        for key in keys:
495	            values = []
496	            for value in forward_data_store:
497	                assert isinstance(value[key], list)
498	                values += value[key]
499	
500	            if args.use_dynamic_batch_size:
501	                # TODO: This is ugly... Find a better way to make the data have the same order.
502	                # TODO: move this out of the loop.
503	                origin_values = [None] * len(values)
504	                origin_indices = sum(data_iterator[0].micro_batch_indices, [])
505	                for value, origin_index in zip(values, origin_indices, strict=False):
506	                    origin_values[origin_index] = value
507	                values = origin_values
508	            rollout_data[f"{store_prefix}{key}"] = values
509	    return rollout_data

512	def train_one_step(
513	    args: Namespace,
514	    rollout_id: int,
515	    step_id: int,
516	    data_iterator: Sequence[DataIterator],
517	    model: Sequence[DDP],
518	    optimizer: MegatronOptimizer,
519	    opt_param_scheduler: OptimizerParamScheduler,
520	    num_microbatches: int,
521	    step_global_batch_size: int,
522	    microbatch_pbar=None,
523	) -> tuple[dict[str, float], float]:
524	    """Execute a single pipeline-parallel training step.
525	
526	    Runs forward/backward over ``num_microbatches``, applies optimizer step and
527	    one scheduler step when gradients are valid.
528	
529	    Args:
530	        args (Namespace): Runtime arguments.
531	        rollout_id (int): Rollout identifier.
532	        step_id (int): Step index within the current rollout.
533	        data_iterator (Sequence[DataIterator]): Iterable(s) yielding training batches.
534	        model (Sequence[DDP]): Sequence of DDP-wrapped model chunks.
535	        optimizer (MegatronOptimizer): Optimizer instance.
536	        opt_param_scheduler (OptimizerParamScheduler): LR/WD scheduler.
537	        num_microbatches (int): Number of microbatches to process.
538	        step_global_batch_size (int): Rollout count for this training step
539	            (total across DP; one "rollout" = one execution of one of the
540	            ``n_samples_per_prompt`` rollouts, which may emit >1 training
541	            sample under compact / subagent). Used both as the loss
542	            normalizer inside the closure and as the LR scheduler
543	            ``increment``. In the common case (1 rollout = 1 sample) this
544	            equals the per-step sample count, so behavior is unchanged.
545	
546	    Returns:
547	        tuple[dict[str, float], float]: Reduced loss dictionary (last stage only)
548	        and gradient norm for logging.
549	    """
550	    args = get_args()
551	
552	    # Set grad to zero.
553	    for model_chunk in model:
554	        model_chunk.zero_grad_buffer()
555	    optimizer.zero_grad()
556	
557	    if args.custom_megatron_before_train_step_hook_path:
558	        from slime.utils.misc import load_function
559	
560	        custom_before_train_step_hook = load_function(args.custom_megatron_before_train_step_hook_path)
561	        custom_before_train_step_hook(args, rollout_id, step_id, model, optimizer, opt_param_scheduler)
562	
563	    def forward_step(data_iterator: DataIterator, model: GPTModel, return_schedule_plan: bool = False) -> tuple[
564	        torch.Tensor,
565	        Callable[[torch.Tensor], tuple[torch.Tensor, int, dict[str, torch.Tensor | list[str]]]],
566	    ]:
567	        """Forward step used by Megatron's pipeline engine during training.
568	
569	        Args:
570	            data_iterator (DataIterator): Input data iterator.
571	            model (GPTModel): The GPT model chunk to execute.
572	
573	        Returns:
574	            tuple[torch.Tensor, Callable[[torch.Tensor], tuple[torch.Tensor, int, dict[str, torch.Tensor | list[str]]]]]:
575	            Output tensor(s) and the loss function, which returns
576	            (loss, num_elems, {"keys": list[str], "values": torch.Tensor}).
577	        """
578	
579	        # Get the batch.
580	        batch = get_batch(
581	            data_iterator,
582	            _with_rollout_top_p_token_keys(
583	                args,
584	                [
585	                    "tokens",
586	                    "multimodal_train_inputs",
587	                    "packed_seq_params",
588	                    "total_lengths",
589	                    "response_lengths",
590	                    "loss_masks",
591	                    "log_probs",
592	                    "ref_log_probs",
593	                    "values",
594	                    "advantages",
595	                    "returns",
596	                    "rollout_log_probs",
597	                    "teacher_log_probs",
598	                    "rollout_mask_sums",
599	                    # Only present when dumping train debug data; lets the loss
600	                    # snapshot each sample's log_probs keyed by rollout position.
601	                    *(["partition"] if args.save_debug_train_data is not None else []),
602	                ],
603	            ),
604	            args.data_pad_size_multiplier,
605	            args.allgather_cp,
606	        )
607	
608	        if os.environ.get("ENABLE_ROUTING_REPLAY", "0") == "1":
609	            old_stage = os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"]
610	            os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "replay_forward"
611	
612	        if return_schedule_plan:
613	            assert not args.enable_mtp_training, "MTP training should not be enabled when using combined 1f1b"
614	            position_ids = None
615	            output_tensor = model.build_schedule_plan(
616	                input_ids=batch["tokens"],
617	                position_ids=position_ids,
618	                attention_mask=None,
619	                labels=None,
620	                packed_seq_params=batch["packed_seq_params"],
621	                loss_mask=batch["full_loss_masks"],
622	            )
623	        else:
624	            forward_kwargs = {
625	                "input_ids": batch["tokens"],
626	                "position_ids": None,
627	                "attention_mask": None,
628	                "labels": None,
629	                "packed_seq_params": batch["packed_seq_params"],
630	                "loss_mask": batch["full_loss_masks"],
631	            }
632	
633	            if batch["multimodal_train_inputs"] is not None:
634	                forward_kwargs.update(batch["multimodal_train_inputs"])
635	
636	            if args.enable_mtp_training:
637	                forward_kwargs["mtp_kwargs"] = {"mtp_labels": batch["tokens"]}
638	
639	            output_tensor = model(**forward_kwargs)
640	
641	        if os.environ.get("ENABLE_ROUTING_REPLAY", "0") == "1":
642	            os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = old_stage
643	
644	        return output_tensor, partial(loss_function, args, batch, num_microbatches, step_global_batch_size)
645	
646	    # Forward pass.
647	    forward_backward_func = get_forward_backward_func()
648	    losses_reduced = forward_backward_func(
649	        forward_step_func=_wrap_forward_step_with_microbatch_pbar(forward_step, microbatch_pbar),
650	        data_iterator=data_iterator,
651	        model=model,
652	        num_microbatches=num_microbatches,
653	        seq_length=args.seq_length,
654	        micro_batch_size=args.micro_batch_size,
655	        decoder_seq_length=args.decoder_seq_length,
656	        forward_only=False,
657	    )
658	
659	    valid_step = True
660	    grad_norm = float("nan")
661	    if not getattr(args, "check_for_nan_in_loss_and_grad", True):
662	        found_inf_flag = optimizer.prepare_grads()
663	        if found_inf_flag:
664	            valid_step = False
665	        else:
666	            grad_norm = optimizer.get_grad_norm()
667	            if isinstance(grad_norm, torch.Tensor):
668	                valid_step = not (torch.isnan(grad_norm) or torch.isinf(grad_norm))
669	            else:
670	                valid_step = not (math.isnan(grad_norm) or math.isinf(grad_norm))
671	
672	    # CI check: verify only MTP parameters have non-zero gradients when truncation happens
673	    # This check must happen before optimizer.step() as gradients may be modified during step
674	    if args.ci_test and args.enable_mtp_training:
675	        from slime.backends.megatron_utils.ci_utils import check_mtp_only_grad
676	
677	        check_mtp_only_grad(model, step_id)
678	
679	    if valid_step:
680	        # Update parameters.
681	        update_successful, grad_norm, num_zeros_in_grad = optimizer.step()
682	
683	        # Update learning rate. Use the per-step global_batch_size when dynamic
684	        # batching is on so the scheduler's samples-seen counter tracks reality.
685	        assert update_successful
686	        opt_param_scheduler.step(increment=step_global_batch_size)
687	
688	    # release grad
689	    for model_chunk in model:
690	        model_chunk.zero_grad_buffer()
691	    optimizer.zero_grad()
692	
693	    if mpu.is_pipeline_last_stage(ignore_virtual=True):
694	        loss_reduced = train_metric_utils.reduce_train_step_metrics(
695	            losses_reduced,
696	            calculate_per_token_loss=args.calculate_per_token_loss,
697	            step_global_batch_size=step_global_batch_size,
698	            cp_size=mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size(),
699	            dp_with_cp_group=mpu.get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True),
700	        )
701	        return loss_reduced, grad_norm
702	    return {}, grad_norm

710	def train(
711	    rollout_id: int,
712	    model: Sequence[DDP],
713	    optimizer: MegatronOptimizer,
714	    opt_param_scheduler: OptimizerParamScheduler,
715	    data_iterator: Sequence[DataIterator],
716	    num_microbatches: Sequence[int],
717	    global_batch_sizes: Sequence[int],
718	) -> None:
719	    """Run training over a rollout consisting of multiple steps.
720	
721	    The model is switched to train mode, training hooks are configured, and
722	    ``train_one_step`` is invoked for each step in the rollout.
723	
724	    Args:
725	        rollout_id (int): Rollout identifier.
726	        model (Sequence[DDP]): Sequence of DDP-wrapped model chunks.
727	        optimizer (MegatronOptimizer): Optimizer instance.
728	        opt_param_scheduler (OptimizerParamScheduler): LR/WD scheduler.
729	        data_iterator (Sequence[DataIterator]): Iterable(s) yielding training batches.
730	        num_microbatches (Sequence[int]): Microbatches per step in the rollout.
731	        global_batch_sizes (Sequence[int]): Rollout count per step (total
732	            across DP; one "rollout" = one execution of one of the
733	            ``n_samples_per_prompt`` rollouts of a prompt). Same length as
734	            ``num_microbatches``; consumed by ``train_one_step`` for loss
735	            scaling and LR scheduler increments. Equals per-step sample count
736	            in the common case (1 rollout = 1 sample).
737	    """
738	    args = get_args()
739	
740	    assert len(num_microbatches) == len(global_batch_sizes), (
741	        f"num_microbatches and global_batch_sizes must have the same length, "
742	        f"got {len(num_microbatches)} vs {len(global_batch_sizes)}"
743	    )
744	
745	    for iterator in data_iterator:
746	        iterator.reset()
747	
748	    # Turn on training mode which enables dropout.
749	    for model_module in model:
750	        model_module.train()
751	
752	    # Setup some training config params.
753	    config = get_model_config(model[0])
754	    config.grad_scale_func = optimizer.scale_loss
755	    config.timers = None
756	    if isinstance(model[0], DDP) and args.overlap_grad_reduce:
757	        assert config.no_sync_func is None, (
758	            "When overlap_grad_reduce is True, config.no_sync_func must be None; "
759	            "a custom no_sync_func is not supported when overlapping grad-reduce"
760	        )
761	        config.no_sync_func = [model_chunk.no_sync for model_chunk in model]
762	        if len(model) == 1:
763	            config.no_sync_func = config.no_sync_func[0]
764	        if args.align_grad_reduce:
765	            config.grad_sync_func = [model_chunk.start_grad_sync for model_chunk in model]
766	            if len(model) == 1:
767	                config.grad_sync_func = config.grad_sync_func[0]
768	    if args.overlap_param_gather and args.align_param_gather:
769	        config.param_sync_func = [model_chunk.start_param_sync for model_chunk in model]
770	        if len(model) == 1:
771	            config.param_sync_func = config.param_sync_func[0]
772	    config.finalize_model_grads_func = finalize_model_grads
773	
774	    pre_hook_enabled = False
775	
776	    if args.reset_optimizer_states:
777	        if (
778	            mpu.get_data_parallel_rank(with_context_parallel=True) == 0
779	            and mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank() == 0
780	            and mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_rank() == mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() - 1
781	        ):
782	            logger.info("Reset optimizer states")
783	        for chained_optimizer in optimizer.chained_optimizers:
784	            for group in chained_optimizer.optimizer.param_groups:
785	                if "step" in group:
786	                    group["step"] = 0
787	            for state in chained_optimizer.optimizer.state.values():
788	                if "step" in state:
789	                    if isinstance(state["step"], torch.Tensor):
790	                        state["step"].zero_()
791	                    else:
792	                        state["step"] = 0
793	                if "exp_avg" in state:
794	                    state["exp_avg"].zero_()
795	                if "exp_avg_sq" in state:
796	                    state["exp_avg_sq"].zero_()
797	
798	    if args.manual_gc:
799	        # Disable the default garbage collector and perform the collection manually.
800	        # This is to align the timing of garbage collection across ranks.
801	        assert args.manual_gc_interval >= 0, "Manual garbage collection interval should be larger than or equal to 0"
802	        gc.disable()
803	        gc.collect()
804	
805	    # Disable forward pre-hook to start training to ensure that errors in checkpoint loading
806	    # or random initialization don't propagate to all ranks in first all-gather (which is a
807	    # no-op if things work correctly).
808	    if should_disable_forward_pre_hook(args):
809	        disable_forward_pre_hook(model, param_sync=False)
810	        # Also remove param_sync_func temporarily so that sync calls made in
811	        # `forward_backward_func` are no-ops.
812	        param_sync_func = config.param_sync_func
813	        config.param_sync_func = None
814	        pre_hook_enabled = False
815	
816	    num_steps_per_rollout = len(num_microbatches)
817	    microbatch_pbar = tqdm(
818	        total=sum(num_microbatches),
819	        desc=f"{getattr(model[0], 'role', 'actor')} train",
820	        unit="microbatch",
821	        dynamic_ncols=True,
822	        leave=False,
823	        disable=_disable_tqdm_for_non_main_rank(),
824	    )
825	
826	    # Run training iterations till done.
827	    for step_id in range(num_steps_per_rollout):
828	
829	        # Run training step.
830	        loss_dict, grad_norm = train_one_step(
831	            args,
832	            rollout_id,
833	            step_id,
834	            data_iterator,
835	            model,
836	            optimizer,
837	            opt_param_scheduler,
838	            num_microbatches[step_id],
839	            global_batch_sizes[step_id],
840	            microbatch_pbar=microbatch_pbar,
841	        )
842	
843	        if step_id == 0:
844	            # Enable forward pre-hook after training step has successfully run. All subsequent
845	            # forward passes will use the forward pre-hook / `param_sync_func` in
846	            # `forward_backward_func`.
847	            if should_disable_forward_pre_hook(args):
848	                enable_forward_pre_hook(model)

import dataclasses
import gc
import logging
import math
import os
from argparse import Namespace
from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
from contextlib import contextmanager, nullcontext
from functools import partial
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from megatron.core import mpu
from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallel as DDP
from megatron.core.distributed import finalize_model_grads
from megatron.core.enums import ModelType
from megatron.core.models.gpt import GPTModel
from megatron.core.optimizer import OptimizerConfig, get_megatron_optimizer
from megatron.core.optimizer.optimizer import MegatronOptimizer
from megatron.core.optimizer_param_scheduler import OptimizerParamScheduler
from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel import get_forward_backward_func
from megatron.core.utils import get_model_config
from megatron.training.global_vars import get_args
from megatron.training.training import get_model
from tqdm import tqdm

try:
    from megatron.core.pipeline_parallel.utils import unwrap_model
except ImportError:
    from megatron.core.utils import unwrap_model
from slime.observability import logging_utils, train_metric_utils
from slime.utils.memory_utils import clear_memory

from .checkpoint import load_checkpoint, save_checkpoint
from .data import DataIterator, get_batch
