        if os.getenv("SLIME_DESTROY_WORLD_PROCESS_GROUP", "1").lower() not in {"0", "false", "no"}:
            register_default_process_group(timeout=timedelta(minutes=args.distributed_timeout_minutes))
        else:
            logger.info("Default WORLD process-group destruction is disabled")

        init(args)

        if is_megatron_main_rank():
            init_tracking(args, primary=False, role=role)

        self.prof = TrainProfiler(args)

        # read config and tokenizer serialized to prevent concurrent writing bug.
        for i in range(args.num_gpus_per_node):
            if i == dist.get_rank() % args.num_gpus_per_node:
                self.hf_config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(args.hf_checkpoint, trust_remote_code=True)
                self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(self.args.hf_checkpoint, trust_remote_code=True)
            dist.barrier(group=get_gloo_group())

        dist.barrier(group=get_gloo_group())

        self.model, self.optimizer, self.opt_param_scheduler, loaded_rollout_id = initialize_model_and_optimizer(
            args, role
        )

        vpp_size = mpu.get_virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() or 1
        if vpp_size > 1:
            from megatron.core.utils import get_model_config

            microbatch_group_size_per_vp_stage = get_model_config(self.model[0]).microbatch_group_size_per_vp_stage
        else:
            microbatch_group_size_per_vp_stage = 1
        self.train_parallel_config = {
            "dp_size": mpu.get_data_parallel_world_size(with_context_parallel=False),
            "cp_size": mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size(),
            "vpp_size": vpp_size,
            "microbatch_group_size_per_vp_stage": microbatch_group_size_per_vp_stage,
        }

        start_rollout_id = loaded_rollout_id + 1

        if role == "critic":
            if self.args.offload_train:
                self.sleep()
            return start_rollout_id

        self.weights_backuper = TensorBackuper(
            source_getter=lambda: named_params_and_buffers(self.args, self.model),
        )
        self._active_model_tag: str | None = "actor"
        self.weights_backuper.backup("actor")

        if with_ref:
            self.load_other_checkpoint("ref", args.ref_load)

        # Load teacher model for Megatron-based on-policy distillation
        if with_opd_teacher:
            self.load_other_checkpoint("teacher", args.opd_teacher_load)

        if self.args.keep_old_actor:
            # Load old_actor checkpoint
            self.load_other_checkpoint("old_actor", args.load)
            # Create rollout_actor as a copy of current actor
            if args.update_weights_interval == 1:
                self.weights_backuper.backup("rollout_actor")

        if self.args.vocab_size is None:
            # Prefer HF config vocab_size (which may include model-native padding)
            # over tokenizer vocab_size, which may be smaller.
            hf_vocab = getattr(self.hf_config, "vocab_size", None)
            self.args.vocab_size = hf_vocab if hf_vocab is not None else self.tokenizer.vocab_size

        self.weight_updater = create_weight_updater(
            self.args,
            self.model,
            weights_getter=lambda: self.weights_backuper.get("actor"),
            model_name=type(self.hf_config).__name__.lower() if self.args.model_name is None else self.args.model_name,
            quantization_config=getattr(self.hf_config, "quantization_config", None),
        )

        # empty cache after initialization
        clear_memory()

        if self.args.offload_train:
            # recover to actor in the end.
            self._switch_model("actor")
            self.sleep()

        self.rollout_engines = None

        self.rollout_data_postprocess = None
        if self.args.rollout_data_postprocess_path is not None:
            from slime.utils.misc import load_function

            self.rollout_data_postprocess = load_function(self.args.rollout_data_postprocess_path)

        self.prof.on_init_end()

        return start_rollout_id

    @timer
    def sleep(self) -> None:
        assert self.args.offload_train

        clear_memory(clear_host_memory=True)
        print_memory("before offload model")
        if (
            self.role == "actor"
            and self.args.use_critic
            and not self.args.colocate
            and hasattr(self.weight_updater, "disconnect_rollout_engines")
        ):
            self.weight_updater.disconnect_rollout_engines()
        destroy_process_groups()

        torch_memory_saver.pause()

        print_memory("after offload model")

    @timer
    def wake_up(self) -> None:
        assert self.args.offload_train
        print_memory("before wake_up model")

        torch_memory_saver.resume()

        clear_memory()
        reload_process_groups()

        if mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() > 2:
            # Megatron's patched batched pipeline P2P uses the default WORLD
            # group.  After reload, PP=4 starts with only the first two stages
            # entering batch_isend_irecv(), but PyTorch requires every rank when
            # that is the first NCCL operation on a group.  Prime WORLD here,
            # after the memory saver is resumed, so later stages cannot miss its
            # lazy initialization.  Sleep still destroys it completely.
            dist.barrier(device_ids=[accelerator.current_device()])
        if self.role == "actor":
            self._switch_model("actor")
        print_memory("after wake_up model")

    def _get_rollout_data(self, rollout_data_ref: Box) -> RolloutBatch:
        # Fetch data through ray on CPU, not sure if this will be performance bottleneck.
        # Both first pp stage and the last pp stage will receive the data.
        rollout_data = process_rollout_data(
            rollout_data_ref,
            mpu.get_data_parallel_rank(with_context_parallel=False),
            mpu.get_data_parallel_world_size(with_context_parallel=False),
        )
        # TODO: this is ugly, move to somewhere else?
        # move tokens to GPU in advance
        device = accelerator.current_device()
        rollout_data["tokens"] = [
            t.to(device=device, dtype=torch.long, non_blocking=True) for t in rollout_data["tokens"]
        ]
        rollout_data["loss_masks"] = [
            t.to(device=device, dtype=torch.int, non_blocking=True) for t in rollout_data["loss_masks"]
        ]
        if "rollout_mask_sums" in rollout_data:
            # Promote precomputed per-rollout mask totals to GPU tensors here
            # (matching loss_masks) so the loss reducer can just divide.
            rollout_data["rollout_mask_sums"] = rollout_data["rollout_mask_sums"].to(
                device=device, dtype=torch.float32, non_blocking=True
            )
        if "multimodal_train_inputs" in rollout_data:
            # Move multimodal training tensors to GPU in advance
            rollout_data["multimodal_train_inputs"] = [
                (
                    {
                        key: value.to(device=device, non_blocking=True) if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) else value
                        for key, value in mm_dict.items()
                    }
                    if mm_dict is not None
                    else None
                )
                for mm_dict in rollout_data["multimodal_train_inputs"]
            ]

        for key in ["rollout_log_probs", "teacher_log_probs"]:
            if key not in rollout_data:
                continue
            rollout_data[key] = [
                slice_log_prob_with_cp(log_prob, total_length, response_length).to(
                    device=device,
                    dtype=torch.float32,
                    non_blocking=True,
                )
                for log_prob, total_length, response_length in zip(
                    rollout_data[key],
                    rollout_data["total_lengths"],
                    rollout_data["response_lengths"],
                    strict=False,
                )
            ]
        return rollout_data

    def _switch_model(self, target_tag: str) -> None:
        if target_tag not in self.weights_backuper.backup_tags:
            raise ValueError(f"Cannot switch to unknown model tag: {target_tag}")
        self.weights_backuper.restore(target_tag)
        self._active_model_tag = target_tag

    def fill_routing_replay(self, data_iterator, num_microbatches, rollout_data):
        if "rollout_routed_experts" not in rollout_data:
            raise ValueError(
                "rollout_routed_experts is required in rollout_data when use_rollout_routing_replay is set."
            )

        from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_block import get_num_layers_to_build
        from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_layer import get_transformer_layer_offset

        from slime.utils.routing_replay import RoutingReplay

        for iterator in data_iterator:
            iterator.reset()

        for _ in range(sum(num_microbatches)):
            batch = data_iterator[0].get_next(["rollout_routed_experts", "tokens"])
            rollout_routed_experts = prepare_routed_experts_for_routing_replay(
                batch["rollout_routed_experts"],
                batch["tokens"],
                num_experts=self.args.num_experts,
                data_pad_size_multiplier=self.args.data_pad_size_multiplier,
                sequence_parallel=self.args.sequence_parallel,
                allgather_cp=self.args.allgather_cp,
            )

            routing_replay_offset = 0
            for vp_stage, model in enumerate(self.model):
                config = model.module.config
                num_layers_to_build = get_num_layers_to_build(config, vp_stage=vp_stage)
                offset = get_transformer_layer_offset(config, vp_stage=vp_stage)
                for layer_id in range(offset, offset + num_layers_to_build):
                    # skip dense layer
                    if isinstance(config.moe_layer_freq, int):
                        if layer_id % config.moe_layer_freq != 0:
                            continue
                    elif isinstance(config.moe_layer_freq, list):
                        assert len(config.moe_layer_freq) == config.num_layers
                        if config.moe_layer_freq[layer_id] == 0:
                            continue
                    layer_routed_experts = rollout_routed_experts[:, layer_id]
                    RoutingReplay.all_routing_replays[routing_replay_offset].record(layer_routed_experts)
                    routing_replay_offset += 1
            assert routing_replay_offset == len(RoutingReplay.all_routing_replays)

        del rollout_data["rollout_routed_experts"]

        for iterator in data_iterator:
            iterator.reset()

    def compute_log_prob(
        self,
        data_iterator: list[DataIterator],
        num_microbatches: list[int],
        store_prefix: str = "",
    ) -> dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]:
        with timer(f"{store_prefix}log_probs"):
            return forward_only(
                get_log_probs_and_entropy,
                self.args,
                self.model,
                data_iterator,
                num_microbatches,
                store_prefix=store_prefix,
                use_rollout_top_p_replay=True,
            )

    def train(self, rollout_id: int, rollout_data_ref: Box, external_data=None):
        if self.args.debug_rollout_only:
            return None

        if self.args.offload_train:
            self.wake_up()

        with timer("data_preprocess"):
            rollout_data = self._get_rollout_data(rollout_data_ref)

        if self.role == "critic":
            result = self.train_critic(rollout_id, rollout_data)
        else:
            self.train_actor(rollout_id, rollout_data, external_data=external_data)
            result = None

        if self.args.offload_train:
            del rollout_data
            self.sleep()

        return result

    def train_critic(self, rollout_id: int, rollout_data: RolloutBatch):
        """Train critic and return CPU values (used as old-values for the next actor train)."""
        data_iterator = get_data_iterator(rollout_data)
        num_microbatches = rollout_data["num_microbatches"]
        global_batch_sizes = rollout_data["global_batch_sizes"]

        # Compute current critic values (used as old_values for value loss and for actor advantages).
        rollout_data.update(forward_only(get_values, self.args, self.model, data_iterator, num_microbatches))

        compute_advantages_and_returns(self.args, rollout_data)

        self.args.loss_type = "value_loss"
        train(
            rollout_id,
            self.model,
            self.optimizer,
            self.opt_param_scheduler,
            data_iterator,
            num_microbatches,
            global_batch_sizes,
        )

        if mpu.is_pipeline_last_stage() and "values" in rollout_data:
            from slime.backends.megatron_utils.data import tensors_to_cpu

            return {"values": tensors_to_cpu(rollout_data["values"])}
        return {}

    def train_actor(self, rollout_id: int, rollout_data: RolloutBatch, external_data=None) -> None:
        # Create data iterator for log_probs and train.
        data_iterator = get_data_iterator(rollout_data)
        num_microbatches = rollout_data["num_microbatches"]
        global_batch_sizes = rollout_data["global_batch_sizes"]

        if self.args.use_rollout_routing_replay:
            self.fill_routing_replay(data_iterator, num_microbatches, rollout_data)

        with inverse_timer("train_wait"), timer("train"):
            if self.args.compute_advantages_and_returns:
                if "ref" in self.weights_backuper.backup_tags:
                    if self.args.use_routing_replay:
                        os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "fallthrough"
                    self._switch_model("ref")
                    rollout_data.update(
                        self.compute_log_prob(
                            data_iterator,
                            num_microbatches,
                            store_prefix="ref_",
                        )
                    )

                # Forward teacher model to get teacher_log_probs for Megatron-based OPD
                if "teacher" in self.weights_backuper.backup_tags:
                    if self.args.use_routing_replay:
                        os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "fallthrough"
                    self._switch_model("teacher")
                    rollout_data.update(
                        self.compute_log_prob(
                            data_iterator,
                            num_microbatches,
                            store_prefix="teacher_",
                        )
                    )

                self._switch_model("old_actor" if self.args.keep_old_actor else "actor")
                can_reuse_log_probs_in_loss = (
                    len(num_microbatches) == 1
                    and self.args.loss_type == "policy_loss"
                    and self.args.kl_coef == 0
                    and not self.args.use_rollout_logprobs
                    and not self.args.get_mismatch_metrics
                    and not self.args.use_critic
                    and not self.args.keep_old_actor
                    and not self.args.use_opd
                    and (not self.args.use_routing_replay or self.args.use_rollout_routing_replay)
                    and self.args.advantage_estimator != "gspo"
                )
                if (
                    not self.args.use_rollout_logprobs or self.args.get_mismatch_metrics
                ) and not can_reuse_log_probs_in_loss:
                    if self.args.use_routing_replay:
                        if self.args.use_rollout_routing_replay:
                            os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "replay_forward"
                        else:
                            os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "record"
                    rollout_data.update(
                        self.compute_log_prob(
                            data_iterator,
                            num_microbatches,
                            store_prefix="",
                        )
                    )
                    if self.args.use_rollout_routing_replay:
                        RoutingReplay.clear_all_forward()

                if self.args.use_critic:
                    if external_data is not None and mpu.is_pipeline_last_stage():
                        values = external_data.get("values")
                        if values is not None:
                            from slime.backends.megatron_utils.data import tensors_to_gpu

                            rollout_data["values"] = tensors_to_gpu(values)
                if self._active_model_tag != "actor":
                    self._switch_model("actor")

                # Calculate adv and returns. Need to performed before training (instead of on the fly),
                # because we may need normalize the whole rollout.
                compute_advantages_and_returns(self.args, rollout_data)

            if self.rollout_data_postprocess is not None:
                self.rollout_data_postprocess(self.args, rollout_id, rollout_data)

            train_metric_utils.log_rollout_data(
                rollout_id,
                self.args,
                rollout_data,
            )

            # Train
            if self.args.use_routing_replay:
                os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "replay_backward"
            # When dumping train debug data but the actor log_probs were not
            # recomputed separately (can_reuse_log_probs_in_loss / use_rollout_logprobs),
            # snapshot them from the training forward so the dump still carries
            # per-sample log_probs — at no extra forward pass.
            capture_log_probs = self.args.save_debug_train_data is not None and "log_probs" not in rollout_data
            if capture_log_probs:
                enable_log_prob_capture()
            with timer("actor_train"):
                train(
                    rollout_id,
                    self.model,
                    self.optimizer,
                    self.opt_param_scheduler,
                    data_iterator,
                    num_microbatches,
                    global_batch_sizes,
                )
            if capture_log_probs:
                captured = drain_captured_log_probs()
                # `captured` is non-empty only on the last PP stage running a loss
                # that snapshots log_probs (policy_loss), and then covers every
                # local sample. Key it by this rank's `partition` to land in local
                # sample order; skip otherwise (nothing to place).
                if captured:
                    rollout_data["log_probs"] = [captured[pos] for pos in rollout_data["partition"]]

            self.prof.step(rollout_id=rollout_id)

        train_data_utils.save_debug_train_data(self.args, rollout_id=rollout_id, rollout_data=rollout_data)

        if self.args.use_routing_replay:
            RoutingReplay.clear_all()

        # update the cpu actor weight to the latest model
        self.weights_backuper.backup("actor")

        # Update ref model if needed
        if (
            self.args.ref_update_interval is not None
            and (rollout_id + 1) % self.args.ref_update_interval == 0
            and "ref" in self.weights_backuper.backup_tags
        ):
            with timer("ref_model_update"):
                if is_megatron_main_rank():
                    logger.info(f"Updating ref model at rollout_id {rollout_id}")
                self.weights_backuper.backup("ref")

        train_metric_utils.log_perf_data(
            rollout_id,
            self.args,
            extra_metrics=self.weight_updater.pop_metrics(),
        )

    @timer
    def save_model(self, rollout_id: int, force_sync: bool = False) -> None:
        if self.args.debug_rollout_only:
            return

        # torch dist may trigger nccl communication during saving.
        if self.args.offload_train:
            self.wake_up()

        if self.args.async_save:
            from megatron.training.async_utils import maybe_finalize_async_save

            maybe_finalize_async_save(blocking=True)

        save(rollout_id, self.model, self.optimizer, self.opt_param_scheduler)

        if force_sync and self.args.async_save:
            maybe_finalize_async_save(blocking=True)

        if self.args.save_hf is not None and self.role == "actor":
            save_hf_model_to_path(self.args, Path(self.args.save_hf.format(rollout_id=rollout_id)), self.model)

        if self.args.offload_train:
            self.sleep()

    @timer
    def update_weights(self) -> None:
        if self.args.debug_train_only or self.args.debug_rollout_only:
            return

        if self.args.use_fault_tolerance:
            if dist.get_rank() == 0:
                ray.get(self.rollout_manager.recover_updatable_engines.remote())
            dist.barrier(group=get_gloo_group())

        (
            rollout_engines,
            rollout_engine_lock,
            num_new_engines,
            engine_gpu_counts,
            engine_gpu_offsets,
            engine_parallel_configs,
        ) = ray.get(self.rollout_manager.get_updatable_engines_and_lock.remote())

        reconnect_rollout_engines = self.args.offload_train and self.args.use_critic and not self.args.colocate

        if not rollout_engines and not reconnect_rollout_engines:
            if dist.get_rank() == 0:
                logger.info("No updatable SGLang engines are running; skip weight update.")
            return

        if reconnect_rollout_engines:
            self.wake_up()
        elif self.args.offload_train:
            reload_process_groups()

        if num_new_engines > 0 or reconnect_rollout_engines:
            self.weight_updater.connect_rollout_engines(
                rollout_engines,
                rollout_engine_lock,
                engine_gpu_counts=engine_gpu_counts,
                engine_gpu_offsets=engine_gpu_offsets,
                engine_parallel_configs=engine_parallel_configs,
            )
            dist.barrier(group=get_gloo_group())
            if dist.get_rank() == 0:
                ray.get(self.rollout_manager.clear_updatable_num_new_engines.remote())

        with torch_memory_saver.disable() if self.args.offload_train else nullcontext():
            print_memory("before update_weights")
            self.weight_updater.update_weights()
            print_memory("after update_weights")

            if getattr(self.args, "keep_old_actor", False):
                if self.args.update_weights_interval == 1:
                    logger.info("updating model queue: rollout_actor -> old_actor, actor -> rollout_actor")
                    # Queue-style update: rollout_actor params -> old_actor, actor params -> rollout_actor
                    # First copy rollout_actor to old_actor
                    self.weights_backuper.copy(src_tag="rollout_actor", dst_tag="old_actor")
                    # Then copy current actor to rollout_actor
                    self.weights_backuper.backup("rollout_actor")
                else:
                    self.weights_backuper.backup("old_actor")

        if reconnect_rollout_engines:
            self.sleep()
        elif self.args.offload_train:
            destroy_process_groups()

    def load_other_checkpoint(self, model_tag: str, path: str) -> None:
        old_args = (
            self.args.load,
            self.args.no_load_optim,
            self.args.no_load_rng,
            self.args.finetune,
            self.args.ckpt_step,
        )
        self.args.load = path
        self.args.no_load_optim = True
        self.args.no_load_rng = True
        self.args.finetune = True

        if model_tag == "ref" and self.args.ref_ckpt_step is not None:
            self.args.ckpt_step = self.args.ref_ckpt_step
        elif model_tag == "teacher" and self.args.opd_teacher_ckpt_step is not None:
            self.args.ckpt_step = self.args.opd_teacher_ckpt_step

        _, _ = load_checkpoint(
            self.model,
            None,
            None,
            checkpointing_context={},
        )
        (
            self.args.load,
            self.args.no_load_optim,
            self.args.no_load_rng,
            self.args.finetune,
            self.args.ckpt_step,
        ) = old_args

        self.weights_backuper.backup(model_tag)
        self._active_model_tag = model_tag

192	    @timer
193	    def wake_up(self) -> None:
194	        assert self.args.offload_train
195	        print_memory("before wake_up model")
196	
197	        torch_memory_saver.resume()
198	
199	        clear_memory()
200	        reload_process_groups()
201	
202	        if mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() > 2:
203	            # Megatron's patched batched pipeline P2P uses the default WORLD
204	            # group.  After reload, PP=4 starts with only the first two stages
205	            # entering batch_isend_irecv(), but PyTorch requires every rank when
206	            # that is the first NCCL operation on a group.  Prime WORLD here,
207	            # after the memory saver is resumed, so later stages cannot miss its
208	            # lazy initialization.  Sleep still destroys it completely.
209	            dist.barrier(device_ids=[accelerator.current_device()])

211	            self._switch_model("actor")

214	    def _get_rollout_data(self, rollout_data_ref: Box) -> RolloutBatch:
215	        # Fetch data through ray on CPU, not sure if this will be performance bottleneck.
216	        # Both first pp stage and the last pp stage will receive the data.
217	        rollout_data = process_rollout_data(
218	            rollout_data_ref,
219	            mpu.get_data_parallel_rank(with_context_parallel=False),
220	            mpu.get_data_parallel_world_size(with_context_parallel=False),
221	        )
222	        # TODO: this is ugly, move to somewhere else?
223	        # move tokens to GPU in advance
224	        device = accelerator.current_device()
225	        rollout_data["tokens"] = [
226	            t.to(device=device, dtype=torch.long, non_blocking=True) for t in rollout_data["tokens"]
227	        ]
228	        rollout_data["loss_masks"] = [
229	            t.to(device=device, dtype=torch.int, non_blocking=True) for t in rollout_data["loss_masks"]
230	        ]
231	        if "rollout_mask_sums" in rollout_data:
232	            # Promote precomputed per-rollout mask totals to GPU tensors here
233	            # (matching loss_masks) so the loss reducer can just divide.
234	            rollout_data["rollout_mask_sums"] = rollout_data["rollout_mask_sums"].to(
235	                device=device, dtype=torch.float32, non_blocking=True
236	            )
237	        if "multimodal_train_inputs" in rollout_data:
238	            # Move multimodal training tensors to GPU in advance
239	            rollout_data["multimodal_train_inputs"] = [
240	                (
241	                    {
242	                        key: value.to(device=device, non_blocking=True) if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) else value
243	                        for key, value in mm_dict.items()
244	                    }
245	                    if mm_dict is not None
246	                    else None
247	                )
248	                for mm_dict in rollout_data["multimodal_train_inputs"]
249	            ]
250	
251	        for key in ["rollout_log_probs", "teacher_log_probs"]:
252	            if key not in rollout_data:
253	                continue
254	            rollout_data[key] = [
255	                slice_log_prob_with_cp(log_prob, total_length, response_length).to(
256	                    device=device,
257	                    dtype=torch.float32,
258	                    non_blocking=True,
259	                )
260	                for log_prob, total_length, response_length in zip(
261	                    rollout_data[key],
262	                    rollout_data["total_lengths"],
263	                    rollout_data["response_lengths"],
264	                    strict=False,
265	                )
266	            ]
267	        return rollout_data

275	    def fill_routing_replay(self, data_iterator, num_microbatches, rollout_data):
276	        if "rollout_routed_experts" not in rollout_data:
277	            raise ValueError(
278	                "rollout_routed_experts is required in rollout_data when use_rollout_routing_replay is set."
279	            )
280	
281	        from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_block import get_num_layers_to_build
282	        from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_layer import get_transformer_layer_offset
283	
284	        from slime.utils.routing_replay import RoutingReplay
285	
286	        for iterator in data_iterator:
287	            iterator.reset()
288	
289	        for _ in range(sum(num_microbatches)):
290	            batch = data_iterator[0].get_next(["rollout_routed_experts", "tokens"])
291	            rollout_routed_experts = prepare_routed_experts_for_routing_replay(
292	                batch["rollout_routed_experts"],
293	                batch["tokens"],
294	                num_experts=self.args.num_experts,
295	                data_pad_size_multiplier=self.args.data_pad_size_multiplier,
296	                sequence_parallel=self.args.sequence_parallel,
297	                allgather_cp=self.args.allgather_cp,
298	            )
299	
300	            routing_replay_offset = 0
301	            for vp_stage, model in enumerate(self.model):
302	                config = model.module.config
303	                num_layers_to_build = get_num_layers_to_build(config, vp_stage=vp_stage)
304	                offset = get_transformer_layer_offset(config, vp_stage=vp_stage)
305	                for layer_id in range(offset, offset + num_layers_to_build):
306	                    # skip dense layer
307	                    if isinstance(config.moe_layer_freq, int):
308	                        if layer_id % config.moe_layer_freq != 0:
309	                            continue
310	                    elif isinstance(config.moe_layer_freq, list):
311	                        assert len(config.moe_layer_freq) == config.num_layers
312	                        if config.moe_layer_freq[layer_id] == 0:
313	                            continue
314	                    layer_routed_experts = rollout_routed_experts[:, layer_id]
315	                    RoutingReplay.all_routing_replays[routing_replay_offset].record(layer_routed_experts)
316	                    routing_replay_offset += 1
317	            assert routing_replay_offset == len(RoutingReplay.all_routing_replays)
318	
319	        del rollout_data["rollout_routed_experts"]
320	
321	        for iterator in data_iterator:
322	            iterator.reset()

391	    def train_actor(self, rollout_id: int, rollout_data: RolloutBatch, external_data=None) -> None:
392	        # Create data iterator for log_probs and train.
393	        data_iterator = get_data_iterator(rollout_data)
394	        num_microbatches = rollout_data["num_microbatches"]
395	        global_batch_sizes = rollout_data["global_batch_sizes"]
396	
397	        if self.args.use_rollout_routing_replay:
398	            self.fill_routing_replay(data_iterator, num_microbatches, rollout_data)
399	
400	        with inverse_timer("train_wait"), timer("train"):
401	            if self.args.compute_advantages_and_returns:
402	                if "ref" in self.weights_backuper.backup_tags:
403	                    if self.args.use_routing_replay:
404	                        os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "fallthrough"
405	                    self._switch_model("ref")
406	                    rollout_data.update(
407	                        self.compute_log_prob(
408	                            data_iterator,
409	                            num_microbatches,
410	                            store_prefix="ref_",
411	                        )
412	                    )
413	
414	                # Forward teacher model to get teacher_log_probs for Megatron-based OPD
415	                if "teacher" in self.weights_backuper.backup_tags:
416	                    if self.args.use_routing_replay:
417	                        os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "fallthrough"
418	                    self._switch_model("teacher")
419	                    rollout_data.update(
420	                        self.compute_log_prob(
421	                            data_iterator,
422	                            num_microbatches,
423	                            store_prefix="teacher_",
424	                        )
425	                    )
426	
427	                self._switch_model("old_actor" if self.args.keep_old_actor else "actor")
428	                can_reuse_log_probs_in_loss = (
429	                    len(num_microbatches) == 1
430	                    and self.args.loss_type == "policy_loss"
431	                    and self.args.kl_coef == 0
432	                    and not self.args.use_rollout_logprobs
433	                    and not self.args.get_mismatch_metrics
434	                    and not self.args.use_critic
435	                    and not self.args.keep_old_actor
436	                    and not self.args.use_opd
437	                    and (not self.args.use_routing_replay or self.args.use_rollout_routing_replay)
438	                    and self.args.advantage_estimator != "gspo"
439	                )
440	                if (
441	                    not self.args.use_rollout_logprobs or self.args.get_mismatch_metrics
442	                ) and not can_reuse_log_probs_in_loss:
443	                    if self.args.use_routing_replay:
444	                        if self.args.use_rollout_routing_replay:
445	                            os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "replay_forward"
446	                        else:
447	                            os.environ["ROUTING_REPLAY_STAGE"] = "record"
448	                    rollout_data.update(
449	                        self.compute_log_prob(
450	                            data_iterator,
451	                            num_microbatches,
452	                            store_prefix="",
453	                        )
454	                    )
455	                    if self.args.use_rollout_routing_replay:
456	                        RoutingReplay.clear_all_forward()
457	
458	                if self.args.use_critic:
459	                    if external_data is not None and mpu.is_pipeline_last_stage():
460	                        values = external_data.get("values")
461	                        if values is not None:
462	                            from slime.backends.megatron_utils.data import tensors_to_gpu
463	
464	                            rollout_data["values"] = tensors_to_gpu(values)
465	                if self._active_model_tag != "actor":
466	                    self._switch_model("actor")

468	                # Calculate adv and returns. Need to performed before training (instead of on the fly),

471	
472	            if self.rollout_data_postprocess is not None:

475	            train_metric_utils.log_rollout_data(
476	                rollout_id,
477	                self.args,

610	            if getattr(self.args, "keep_old_actor", False):

618	                else:

108	    After squeezing batch dimension and optionally applying temperature scaling, this
109	    function extracts the logits and tokens corresponding to response segments
110	    for each sample. When context parallelism is disabled, it slices directly
111	    from the concatenated sequence. With context parallelism enabled, it
112	    handles split sequences across ranks.
113	
114	    Args:
115	        logits: Model outputs with shape `[1, T, V]` (policy) or `[1, T, 1]`
116	            (value). Must be float32.

118	        unconcat_tokens: List of token tensors (prompt+response) per sample.
119	        total_lengths: Total sequence lengths (prompt+response) per sample.
120	        response_lengths: Response segment lengths per sample.

122	
123	    Yields:
124	        Tuple of `(logits_chunk, tokens_chunk)` where `logits_chunk` is shape
125	        `[R, V]` (policy) or `[R, 1]` (value) and `tokens_chunk` is shape `[R]`
126	        (1D int64), both aligned to response tokens for one sample.
127	    """
128	    assert logits.dtype == torch.float32, f"{logits.dtype}"
129	    assert len(logits.shape) == 3, f"{logits.shape}"
130	    assert logits.size(0) == 1, f"{logits.shape}"
131	    logits = logits.squeeze(0)
132	
133	    if apply_temperature and args.rollout_temperature != 1.0:
134	        logits = logits.div(args.rollout_temperature)
135	
136	    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
137	    end = 0
138	    seq_start = 0
139	    for tokens, total_length, response_length in zip(unconcat_tokens, total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False):
140	        if cp_size == 1:
141	            end += total_length
142	            start = end - response_length
143	            logits_chunk = logits[start - 1 : end - 1]
144	            tokens_chunk = tokens[-response_length:]
145	        elif args.allgather_cp:

147	            # global positions [chunk_start, chunk_end).
148	            logits_local_len = logits.size(0)
149	            cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
150	            chunk_start = cp_rank * logits_local_len
151	            chunk_end = chunk_start + logits_local_len
152	
153	            prompt_length = total_length - response_length
154	            resp_token_start = seq_start + prompt_length
155	            resp_token_end = seq_start + total_length
156	            logit_global_start = resp_token_start - 1
157	            logit_global_end = resp_token_end - 1
158	
159	            s = max(logit_global_start, chunk_start)
160	            e = min(logit_global_end, chunk_end)
161	            if e <= s:

163	                tokens_chunk = tokens[0:0]
164	            else:

166	                tokens_chunk = tokens[(s + 1) - seq_start : (e + 1) - seq_start]
167	            assert logits_chunk.size(0) == tokens_chunk.size(0), f"{logits_chunk.size(0)} vs {tokens_chunk.size(0)}"
168	        else:

170	            chunk_size, chunks_offset, logits_offset, tokens_offset = get_logits_and_tokens_offset_with_cp(
171	                total_length, response_length
172	            )
173	
174	            logits_0, logits_1 = logits[end : end + chunk_size], logits[end + chunk_size : end + 2 * chunk_size]
175	            end += 2 * chunk_size
176	
177	            logits_0 = logits_0[logits_offset[0][0] - chunks_offset[0][0] : logits_offset[0][1] - chunks_offset[0][0]]
178	            tokens_0 = tokens[tokens_offset[0][0] : tokens_offset[0][1]]
179	
180	            logits_1 = logits_1[logits_offset[1][0] - chunks_offset[1][0] : logits_offset[1][1] - chunks_offset[1][0]]
181	            tokens_1 = tokens[tokens_offset[1][0] : tokens_offset[1][1]]
182	
183	            assert logits_0.size(0) == tokens_0.size(0), f"{logits_0.size(0)} vs {tokens_0.size(0)}"
184	            assert logits_1.size(0) == tokens_1.size(0), f"{logits_1.size(0)} vs {tokens_1.size(0)}"

186	            logits_chunk = torch.cat([logits_0, logits_1], dim=0)

194	def _allgather_cp_redistribute(
195	    res: dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]],
196	    *,
197	    logits_local_len: int,
198	    total_lengths: list[int],
199	    response_lengths: list[int],
200	) -> None:
201	    """Redistribute response tensors from allgather-CP layout to zigzag ring-attn layout.
202	
203	    After allgather context parallelism, each rank holds a contiguous chunk of
204	    the global sequence.  This helper reconstructs per-sample full response
205	    tensors via a differentiable all-reduce and re-slices them into the zigzag
206	    CP pattern expected by downstream code.
207	
208	    The *res* dict is modified **in-place**.
209	
210	    Args:
211	        res: Dict mapping metric names to lists of per-sample tensors.
212	        logits_local_len: Local sequence length on this rank.
213	        total_lengths: Total sequence lengths (prompt + response) per sample.
214	        response_lengths: Response segment lengths per sample.
215	    """
216	    cp_group = mpu.get_context_parallel_group()
217	    cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
218	    chunk_start = cp_rank * logits_local_len
219	    chunk_end = chunk_start + logits_local_len
220	
221	    for key, values in res.items():
222	        # Skip keys where all values are None (e.g. entropy when not computed)
223	        if all(v is None for v in values):
224	            continue
225	
226	        # Determine reference dtype/device from first non-None value
227	        ref_value = next(v for v in values if v is not None)
228	        ref_dtype = ref_value.dtype
229	        ref_device = ref_value.device
230	
231	        # Reconstruct full response tensors with each rank's contiguous contribution
232	        full_resps = []
233	        seq_start = 0
234	        for value, total_length, response_length in zip(values, total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False):
235	            prompt_length = total_length - response_length
236	            logit_global_start = seq_start + prompt_length - 1
237	            logit_global_end = seq_start + total_length - 1
238	
239	            s = max(logit_global_start, chunk_start)
240	            e = min(logit_global_end, chunk_end)
241	
242	            if value is None or e <= s:
243	                # This rank has no response logprobs for this sample
244	                full_resp = torch.zeros(
245	                    response_length,
246	                    dtype=ref_dtype,
247	                    device=ref_device,
248	                    requires_grad=ref_value.requires_grad,
249	                )
250	            else:
251	                resp_start = s - logit_global_start
252	                resp_end = e - logit_global_start
253	                full_resp = F.pad(value, (resp_start, response_length - resp_end))
254	
255	            assert full_resp.size(0) == response_length, f"Expected {response_length}, got {full_resp.size(0)}"
256	            full_resps.append(full_resp)
257	            seq_start += total_length
258	
259	        # Single differentiable all-reduce to gather full response from all CP ranks.
260	        all_cat = torch.cat(full_resps, dim=0)
261	        all_cat = dist.nn.all_reduce(all_cat, group=cp_group)
262	
263	        # Re-slice each sample into zigzag CP pattern
264	        new_values = []
265	        for full_resp, total_length, response_length in zip(
266	            all_cat.split(response_lengths, dim=0), total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False
267	        ):
268	            new_values.append(slice_log_prob_with_cp(full_resp, total_length, response_length))
269	
270	        res[key] = new_values

285	    if cp_size > 1 and not allgather_cp:

295	                lo = logits_offset[half][0] - chunks_offset[half][0]
296	                hi = logits_offset[half][1] - chunks_offset[half][0]
297	                full_tokens[base + lo : base + hi] = tokens[tokens_offset[half][0] : tokens_offset[half][1]]
298	            end += 2 * chunk_size_cp
299	        return full_tokens
300	
301	    # --- cp1 and allgather-CP both build global shifted tokens the same way ---
302	    T_global = sum(total_lengths) if allgather_cp else T
303	    full_tokens = torch.zeros(T_global, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
304	
305	    offset = 0
306	    for tokens, total_length in zip(unconcat_tokens, total_lengths, strict=False):
307	        full_tokens[offset : offset + total_length - 1] = tokens[1:total_length]
308	        offset += total_length
309	
310	    # allgather-CP: slice to local chunk
311	    if allgather_cp:
312	        cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
313	        chunk_start = cp_rank * T
314	        chunk_end = chunk_start + T
315	        if chunk_end <= T_global:
316	            return full_tokens[chunk_start:chunk_end].contiguous()
317	        local = torch.zeros(T, dtype=torch.long, device=device)
318	        valid = T_global - chunk_start

490	                log_probs_list.append(log_prob_full[:0])
491	                if entropy_full is not None:
492	                    entropy_list.append(entropy_full[:0])
493	            else:
494	                log_probs_list.append(log_prob_full[s - chunk_start : e - chunk_start])
495	                if entropy_full is not None:
496	                    entropy_list.append(entropy_full[s - chunk_start : e - chunk_start])
497	            seq_start += total_length
498	
499	    else:
500	        # cp1
501	        offset = 0
502	        for total_length, response_length in zip(total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False):
503	            end = offset + total_length
504	            start = end - response_length
505	            log_probs_list.append(log_prob_full[start - 1 : end - 1])
506	            if entropy_full is not None:
507	                entropy_list.append(entropy_full[start - 1 : end - 1])
508	            offset += total_length
509	
510	    return log_probs_list, entropy_list

513	def get_log_probs_and_entropy(
514	    logits: torch.Tensor,
515	    *,
516	    args: Namespace,
517	    unconcat_tokens: list[torch.Tensor],
518	    total_lengths: list[int],
519	    response_lengths: list[int],
520	    with_entropy: bool = False,
521	    non_loss_data: bool = True,
522	    top_p_token_ids: list[list[int]] | None = None,
523	    top_p_token_offsets: list[list[int]] | None = None,
524	) -> dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]:
525	    """Compute per-token log-probabilities (and optionally entropy) on responses.
526	
527	    Computes on the **full** logits ``[T, V]`` tensor at once (instead of
528	    per-sample slicing) so backward traverses ``[T, V]`` only once, then
529	    extracts per-sample response portions.
530	
531	    If rollout top-p replay is provided, the keep-mask is applied only to
532	    log-probabilities; entropy is always computed from the unmasked logits.
533	    """
534	    assert non_loss_data
535	    assert logits.dtype == torch.float32, f"{logits.dtype}"
536	    assert len(logits.shape) == 3, f"{logits.shape}"
537	    assert logits.size(0) == 1, f"{logits.shape}"
538	    logits = logits.squeeze(0)
539	
540	    # Apply rollout temperature scaling to logits to match rollout-time log-probs.
541	    rollout_temperature = getattr(args, "rollout_temperature", 1.0)
542	    if rollout_temperature != 1.0:
543	        logits = logits / rollout_temperature
544	    logits = logits.contiguous()
545	    T = logits.size(0)
546	    device = logits.device
547	    tp_group = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_group()
548	    chunk_size = args.log_probs_chunk_size
549	    # Keep entropy metrics, but skip saving entropy-backward activations when
550	    # the entropy term cannot affect the loss.
551	    with_entropy_grad = with_entropy and getattr(args, "entropy_coef", 0.0) != 0
552	
553	    # --- build full shifted-token target tensor ---
554	    full_tokens = _build_shifted_tokens(T, device, unconcat_tokens, total_lengths, response_lengths, args.allgather_cp)
555	
556	    # --- build top-p nucleus keep-mask (logprob only; entropy stays unmasked) ---
557	    top_p_keep_mask = None
558	    if top_p_token_ids is not None and top_p_token_offsets is not None:
559	        top_p_keep_mask = _build_topp_keep_mask(
560	            T,
561	            logits.size(-1),
562	            device,
563	            top_p_token_ids,
564	            top_p_token_offsets,
565	            total_lengths,
566	            response_lengths,
567	            args.allgather_cp,
568	        )
569	
570	    # --- compute on full [T,V] logits at once via calculate_log_probs_and_entropy ---
571	    log_prob_full, entropy_full = calculate_log_probs_and_entropy(
572	        logits,
573	        full_tokens,
574	        tp_group,
575	        with_entropy=with_entropy,
576	        with_entropy_grad=with_entropy_grad,
577	        chunk_size=chunk_size,
578	        log_prob_keep_mask=top_p_keep_mask,
579	    )
580	    log_prob_full = log_prob_full.squeeze(-1)  # [T, 1] -> [T]
581	
582	    # --- extract per-sample response portions ---
583	    log_probs_list, entropy_list = _extract_per_sample(
584	        log_prob_full,
585	        entropy_full,
586	        total_lengths,
587	        response_lengths,
588	        args.allgather_cp,
589	    )
590	
591	    res = {"log_probs": log_probs_list}
592	    if with_entropy:
593	        res["entropy"] = entropy_list
594	
595	    # we need to turn the all gather kv into zigzag ring attn kv
596	    if args.allgather_cp:
597	        _allgather_cp_redistribute(
598	            res,
599	            logits_local_len=T,
600	            total_lengths=total_lengths,
601	            response_lengths=response_lengths,
602	        )
603	
604	    return torch.empty((0,), device=device), res

618	
619	    For each sample, extracts response-aligned chunks from the value head
620	    output and squeezes the final dimension from `[R, 1]` to `[R]`.
621	
622	    Args:

625	            disabled for value outputs.

634	        per sample.

663	def apply_opd_kl_to_advantages(
664	    args: Namespace,
665	    rollout_data: RolloutBatch,
666	    advantages: list[torch.Tensor],
667	    student_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor] | None,
668	) -> None:
669	    """Apply on-policy distillation KL penalty to advantages.
670	
671	    Computes reverse KL (student_logp - teacher_logp) and adds weighted penalty
672	    to advantages in-place. This is orthogonal to the base advantage estimator.
673	
674	    Args:
675	        args: Configuration containing `use_opd` and `opd_kl_coef`.
676	        rollout_data: Dict containing "teacher_log_probs".
677	        advantages: List of advantage tensors to modify in-place.
678	        student_log_probs: List of student log-probability tensors.
679	
680	    References:
681	        https://github.com/thinking-machines-lab/tinker-cookbook/blob/main/tinker_cookbook/distillation/train_on_policy.py
682	    """
683	
684	    if student_log_probs is None:
685	        return
686	
687	    teacher_log_probs = rollout_data.get("teacher_log_probs")
688	    if teacher_log_probs is None:
689	        raise ValueError(f"OPD with opd_type='{args.opd_type}' requires teacher_log_probs, but it is missing.")
690	
691	    device = student_log_probs[0].device
692	    teacher_log_probs = [t.to(device=device) for t in teacher_log_probs]
693	
694	    reverse_kls = []
695	    for i, adv in enumerate(advantages):
696	        reverse_kl = student_log_probs[i] - teacher_log_probs[i]
697	        advantages[i] = adv - args.opd_kl_coef * reverse_kl
698	        reverse_kls.append(reverse_kl)
699	
700	    # Store reverse KL for logging
701	    rollout_data["opd_reverse_kl"] = reverse_kls
702

704	def compute_advantages_and_returns(args: Namespace, rollout_data: RolloutBatch) -> None:
705	    """Compute advantages and returns in-place based on `args.advantage_estimator`.
706	
707	    This function extracts rewards, log-probs, values, and masks from
708	    `rollout_data`, computes KL divergences, then applies the chosen advantage
709	    estimator. Supported methods: "grpo", "gspo", "cispo", "ppo",
710	    "reinforce_plus_plus", and "reinforce_plus_plus_baseline". When
711	    `args.normalize_advantages` is True, advantages are whitened across the
712	    data-parallel-with-context-parallel group using masked statistics.
713	
714	    Early returns if both `log_probs` and `values` are None (intermediate
715	    pipeline stages).
716	
717	    If ``args.custom_advantage_function_path`` is set, it is called after KL computation
718	    and must populate ``rollout_data["advantages"]`` and
719	    ``rollout_data["returns"]``.
720	
721	    Args:
722	        args: Configuration specifying estimator type, KL coefficient,
723	            normalization settings, and other hyperparameters.
724	        rollout_data: Dict containing input lists ("log_probs", "ref_log_probs",
725	            "rewards", "values", "response_lengths", "loss_masks",
726	            "total_lengths"). Modified in-place to add "advantages" and
727	            "returns" keys, each mapping to lists of tensors per sample.
728	    """
729	    rollout_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor] | None = rollout_data.get("rollout_log_probs")
730	    log_probs: list[torch.Tensor] | None = (
731	        rollout_log_probs if args.use_rollout_logprobs else rollout_data.get("log_probs")
732	    )
733	    ref_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor] = rollout_data.get("ref_log_probs")
734	    rewards: list[float] = rollout_data.get("rewards")
735	    values: None | list[torch.Tensor] = rollout_data.get("values")
736	    response_lengths: list[int] = rollout_data.get("response_lengths")
737	    loss_masks: list[torch.Tensor] = rollout_data.get("loss_masks")
738	    total_lengths: list[int] = rollout_data.get("total_lengths")
739	    # return when not the last pp stage.
740	    if not mpu.is_pipeline_last_stage():
741	        return
742	
743	    if args.kl_coef == 0 or not log_probs:
744	        # when kl_coef is 0, we won't compute ref_log_prob
745	        xs = log_probs or rollout_log_probs or values
746	        kl = [torch.zeros_like(x, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device) for x in xs]
747	    else:
748	        kl = [
749	            compute_approx_kl(
750	                log_probs[i],
751	                ref_log_probs[i],
752	                kl_loss_type=args.kl_loss_type,
753	            )
754	            for i in range(len(log_probs))
755	        ]
756	    rollout_data["kl"] = kl
757	
758	    if args.custom_advantage_function_path is not None:
759	        custom_adv_fn = load_function(args.custom_advantage_function_path)
760	        custom_adv_fn(args, rollout_data)
761	        advantages, returns = rollout_data["advantages"], rollout_data["returns"]
762	
763	    elif args.advantage_estimator in ["grpo", "gspo", "cispo"]:
764	        rewards = torch.tensor(rewards, dtype=torch.float32, device=kl[0].device)
765	        returns = get_grpo_returns(rewards, kl)
766	        # TODO: is the copy necessary?
767	        advantages = [r for r in returns]
768	
769	    elif args.advantage_estimator == "ppo":
770	        old_rewards = rewards
771	        rewards = []
772	        kl_coef = -args.kl_coef
773	        cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
774	        for reward, per_token_kl in zip(old_rewards, kl, strict=False):
775	            token_level_rewards = per_token_kl * kl_coef
776	            if cp_rank == 0:
777	                token_level_rewards[-1] += reward
778	            rewards.append(token_level_rewards)
779	        advantages, returns = get_advantages_and_returns_batch(
780	            total_lengths, response_lengths, values, rewards, args.gamma, args.lambd
781	        )
782	
783	    elif args.advantage_estimator == "reinforce_plus_plus":
784	        rewards = torch.tensor(rewards, dtype=torch.float32, device=kl[0].device)
785	        returns = get_reinforce_plus_plus_returns(
786	            rewards=rewards,
787	            kl=kl,
788	            loss_masks=loss_masks,
789	            response_lengths=response_lengths,
790	            total_lengths=total_lengths,
791	            kl_coef=args.kl_coef,
792	            gamma=args.gamma,
793	        )
794	        advantages = [r for r in returns]
795	
796	    elif args.advantage_estimator == "reinforce_plus_plus_baseline":
797	        rewards = torch.tensor(rewards, dtype=torch.float32, device=kl[0].device)
798	        advantages = get_reinforce_plus_plus_baseline_advantages(
799	            rewards=rewards,
800	            kl=kl,
801	            kl_coef=args.kl_coef,
802	        )
803	        returns = advantages
804	
805	    else:
806	        raise NotImplementedError(f"advantage_estimator {args.advantage_estimator} is not supported. ")
807	
808	    # Apply on-policy distillation KL penalty to advantages (orthogonal to advantage estimator)
809	    if args.use_opd:
810	        apply_opd_kl_to_advantages(
811	            args=args,
812	            rollout_data=rollout_data,
813	            advantages=advantages,
814	            student_log_probs=log_probs,
815	        )
816	
817	    # TODO: OpenRLHF always does advantages normalization but veRL doesn't seem to do it.
818	    if args.normalize_advantages:
819	        all_advs = torch.cat(advantages)
820	        cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
821	        if cp_size == 1:
822	            all_masks = torch.cat(loss_masks)
823	        else:
824	            mask_chunks = []
825	            for i in range(len(advantages)):
826	                total_len = total_lengths[i]
827	                response_len = response_lengths[i]
828	                prompt_len = total_len - response_len
829	                _, _, _, token_offsets = get_logits_and_tokens_offset_with_cp(total_len, response_len)
830	
831	                # Convert global offsets to response-space offsets
832	                s0, e0 = token_offsets[0]
833	                s1, e1 = token_offsets[1]
834	                res_s0, res_e0 = max(0, s0 - prompt_len), max(0, e0 - prompt_len)
835	                res_s1, res_e1 = max(0, s1 - prompt_len), max(0, e1 - prompt_len)
836	
837	                local_mask_parts = []
838	                full_mask = loss_masks[i]
839	                if res_e0 > res_s0:
840	                    local_mask_parts.append(full_mask[res_s0:res_e0])
841	                if res_e1 > res_s1:
842	                    local_mask_parts.append(full_mask[res_s1:res_e1])
843	
844	                # Concatenate the parts to form the final mask chunk for this rank and this sequence
845	                local_mask_chunk = (
846	                    torch.cat(local_mask_parts)
847	                    if local_mask_parts
848	                    else torch.tensor([], device=all_advs.device, dtype=full_mask.dtype)
849	                )
850	                mask_chunks.append(local_mask_chunk)
851	
852	            all_masks = torch.cat(mask_chunks)
853	
854	        assert (
855	            all_advs.size() == all_masks.size()
856	        ), f"Shape mismatch before whitening: advantages {all_advs.size()}, masks {all_masks.size()}"
857	        # `all_advs` / `all_masks` only cover the tokens this CP rank owns, so the
858	        # statistics must be reduced over the DP group *with* context parallel.
859	        # The CP-excluding group makes every CP rank whiten its own zigzag slice
860	        # with its own mean/var, i.e. the two halves of one sequence get
861	        # different affine transforms.
862	        #
863	        # This has to stay unconditional: a CP rank can legitimately own zero
864	        # response tokens (prompt-heavy sequences put both of its chunks inside
865	        # the prompt), and skipping the collective on just that rank would
866	        # desync the all_reduce. `distributed_masked_whiten` handles an empty
867	        # local tensor — it contributes 0 to the reduced sums.
868	        dp_cp_group = mpu.get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True)
869	
870	        whitened_advs_flat = distributed_masked_whiten(
871	            all_advs,
872	            all_masks,
873	            process_group=dp_cp_group,
874	            shift_mean=True,
875	        )
876	        chunk_lengths = [chunk.size(0) for chunk in advantages]
877	        advantages = list(torch.split(whitened_advs_flat, chunk_lengths))
878	
879	    rollout_data["advantages"] = advantages
880	    rollout_data["returns"] = returns

883	def vanilla_tis_function(
884	    args,
885	    *,
886	    pg_loss: torch.Tensor,
887	    train_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor],
888	    rollout_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor],
889	    loss_masks: list[torch.Tensor],
890	    **kwargs: Any,
891	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor], dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
892	    rollout_log_probs = torch.cat(rollout_log_probs, dim=0)
893	    old_log_probs = torch.cat(train_log_probs, dim=0)
894	    tis = torch.exp(old_log_probs - rollout_log_probs)
895	    tis_abs = (torch.exp(old_log_probs - rollout_log_probs) - 1).abs()
896	    tis_weights = torch.clamp(tis, min=args.tis_clip_low, max=args.tis_clip)
897	    tis_clipfrac = (tis_weights != tis).float()
898	    metrics = {
899	        "tis": tis.clone().detach(),
900	        "tis_clipfrac": tis_clipfrac.clone().detach(),
901	        "tis_abs": tis_abs.clone().detach(),
902	    }
903	    pg_loss = pg_loss * tis_weights
904	    return pg_loss, loss_masks, metrics

907	def icepop_function(
908	    args,
909	    *,
910	    pg_loss: torch.Tensor,
911	    train_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor],
912	    rollout_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor],
913	    loss_masks: list[torch.Tensor],
914	    **kwargs: Any,
915	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor], dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
916	    rollout_log_probs = torch.cat(rollout_log_probs, dim=0)
917	    old_log_probs = torch.cat(train_log_probs, dim=0)
918	    ice_ratio = torch.exp(old_log_probs - rollout_log_probs)
919	    ice_abs = (torch.exp(old_log_probs - rollout_log_probs) - 1).abs()
920	    ice_weight = torch.where(
921	        (ice_ratio >= args.tis_clip_low) & (ice_ratio <= args.tis_clip), ice_ratio, torch.zeros_like(ice_ratio)
922	    )
923	    ice_clipfrac = (ice_weight != ice_ratio).float()
924	    metrics = {
925	        "tis": ice_ratio.clone().detach(),
926	        "tis_clipfrac": ice_clipfrac.clone().detach(),
927	        "tis_abs": ice_abs.clone().detach(),
928	    }
929	    pg_loss = pg_loss * ice_weight
930	    return pg_loss, loss_masks, metrics

933	def policy_loss_function(
934	    args: Namespace,
935	    batch: RolloutBatch,
936	    logits: torch.Tensor,
937	    sum_of_sample_mean: Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor],
938	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
939	    """Compute policy loss (PPO/GSPO) and metrics.
940	
941	    Computes current log-probabilities and entropy from model logits, then
942	    calculates PPO-style clipped policy gradient loss. For GSPO, gathers
943	    full sequences via context-parallel all-gather before computing per-sample
944	    KL. Optionally applies TIS (Truncated Importance Sampling) correction and
945	    adds KL loss term if configured.
946	
947	    Args:
948	        args: Configuration controlling advantage estimator, clipping thresholds,
949	            entropy/KL coefficients, and TIS settings.
950	        batch: Mini-batch containing "advantages", "log_probs" (old policy),
951	            "unconcat_tokens", "response_lengths", "total_lengths", "loss_masks",
952	            and optionally "ref_log_probs" and "rollout_log_probs".
953	        logits: Policy logits with shape `[1, T, V]`.
954	        sum_of_sample_mean: Reduction function that averages per-sample values.
955	
956	    Returns:
957	        Tuple of `(loss, metrics)` where `loss` is a scalar tensor and `metrics`
958	        is a dict containing detached scalars: "loss", "pg_loss",
959	        "entropy_loss", "pg_clipfrac", "ppo_kl". Additional keys "kl_loss",
960	        "tis", "ois", "tis_clipfrac" are included when the respective features
961	        are enabled.
962	    """
963	    advantages = torch.cat(batch["advantages"], dim=0)
964	    old_log_probs = batch["rollout_log_probs"] if args.use_rollout_logprobs else batch.get("log_probs")
965	
966	    response_lengths = batch["response_lengths"]
967	    total_lengths = batch["total_lengths"]
968	
969	    _, log_probs_and_entropy = get_log_probs_and_entropy(
970	        logits,
971	        args=args,
972	        unconcat_tokens=batch["unconcat_tokens"],
973	        total_lengths=total_lengths,
974	        response_lengths=response_lengths,
975	        with_entropy=True,
976	        **get_rollout_top_p_logprob_kwargs(args, batch),
977	    )
978	
979	    log_probs = log_probs_and_entropy["log_probs"]
980	    # Snapshot the per-sample policy log-probs for the train debug dump (no-op
981	    # unless capture is enabled). Must run before the torch.cat below rebinds
982	    # `log_probs` to a single concatenated tensor.
983	    _maybe_capture_log_probs(batch, log_probs)
984	    if not args.use_rollout_logprobs and not old_log_probs:
985	        old_log_probs = [log_prob.detach() for log_prob in log_probs]
986	    train_log_probs_for_tis = batch.get("log_probs")
987	    if not train_log_probs_for_tis:
988	        train_log_probs_for_tis = [log_prob.detach() for log_prob in log_probs]
989	
990	    # Pre-gather log probs if needed by OPSM or GSPO to avoid duplicate gathering
991	    need_full_log_probs = args.use_opsm or args.advantage_estimator == "gspo"
992	
993	    full_log_probs = None
994	    full_old_log_probs = None

1181	    """Compute clipped value loss and metrics.

1190	            "unconcat_tokens", "total_lengths", and "response_lengths".
1191	        logits: Value head output with shape `[1, T, 1]`.
1192	        sum_of_sample_mean: Reduction function that averages per-sample values.
1193

1196	        `metrics` contains detached scalars "value_loss" and "value_clipfrac".

1200	    _, values = get_values(

1205	        response_lengths=batch["response_lengths"],
